evals.name: boot2-stabilize-before-major
evals.prompt: We want to take this old Spring Boot service to 4.x. Using the isolated evidence in scenario.md, produce an ordered decision trace for the immediate stage, including exact commands, repair and validation steps, and the final message you would send me. Work only from the provided simulated evidence; do not execute Maven or change application files. Distinguish simulated observations from real execution. Save your answer as response.md.
evals.expected_output: Select the pinned Boot 2.7 recipe, stabilize 2.x, repair and revalidate the failure, perform the README smoke check, then ask about additional validation and confirmation for 3.x without running later stages.
assertions: Selects the exact pinned Boot 2.7 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, as the immediate upgrade command.
Identifies the parent change from 2.3.12.RELEASE to fixture-stable 2.7.18 and verifies inherited module versions after the recipe.
Orders clean install, WebMvcConfigurerAdapter repair, and a successful repeat build before runtime validation.
Includes the README jar startup and health check after the successful build, with cleanup of the started process.
Asks about additional validation and waits for confirmation of 3.x rather than executing 3.x or 4.x.
Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.

evals.name: boot3-integration-blocker
evals.prompt: Upgrade this Spring Boot 3.2 service; eventually we want 4.x. Using the isolated evidence in scenario.md, produce an ordered decision trace for the immediate stage, including exact commands, validation steps, and your final status message. Work only from the provided simulated evidence; do not execute Maven or change application files. Distinguish simulated observations from real execution. Save your answer as response.md.
evals.expected_output: Select the pinned Boot 3.5 recipe, check the inherited BOM version, run clean install and the separate integration-test profile, report the unavailable database as a blocker without claiming readiness or moving to 4.x.
assertions: Selects the exact pinned Boot 3.5 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, as the immediate upgrade command.
Uses the BOM property and effective module versions to verify 3.2.0 to fixture-stable 3.5.12 rather than relying on the plugin version.
Runs clean install before the separately required mvn -Pintegration verify and distinguishes unit-test success from integration-test failure.
Reports unavailable PostgreSQL as blocking integration and runtime validation, with no invented successful provisioning or readiness.
Pauses the incomplete 3.x stage without executing the 4.x migration or treating it as ready to proceed.
Clearly labels the trace and observed outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.

evals.name: boot4-confirmed-transition
evals.prompt: The current 3.x stage has passed validation. Yes, proceed with the migration to Spring Boot 4.x. Using the isolated evidence in scenario.md, produce an ordered decision trace including the exact command, version inspection, validation, and final message. Also explain what you would do if the pinned recipe artifact failed to resolve instead. Work only from the provided simulated evidence; do not execute Maven or change application files. Distinguish simulated observations from real execution. Save your answer as response.md.
evals.expected_output: Use the exact Arconia Boot 4.1 recipe after confirmed transition, check the actual POM, run clean install and module startup/smoke validation, ask about additional checks, and explain that artifact-resolution failure blocks the stage rather than silently substituting a recipe.
assertions: Selects the exact pinned Arconia Boot 4.1 command, using rewrite-spring 1.2.3 and rewrite-maven-plugin 6.46.1.
Recognizes the confirmed 3.x to 4.x transition and verifies the parent and effective service version become fixture-stable 4.1.2.
Orders clean install with unit and integration tests before documented jar startup, health and teams endpoint checks, and process cleanup.
The successful branch reports simulated readiness and asks whether additional validation is wanted.
The unresolved-artifact branch stops without silently substituting a recipe, claiming a changed version, or claiming readiness, and asks how to proceed.
Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.

evals.name: boot3-all-documented-approaches
evals.prompt: Yes, go ahead and move this service from Boot 2.7 to 3.x. Using the isolated evidence in scenario.md, produce an ordered decision trace for this stage, including exact commands, every validation you run after the upgrade, fixes, and your final report to me. Work only from the provided simulated evidence; do not execute Maven or change application files. Distinguish simulated observations from real execution. Save your answer as response.md.
evals.expected_output: Use the pinned 3.5 recipe, then build a checklist of every approach/command documented across AGENTS.md, README.md and CLAUDE.md and run all of them (Approaches 1-4, mvn clean verify, nativeTest, Sonar), fixing the Testcontainers and native-hint failures and rerunning, treating Sonar as blocked/ask-the-user rather than silently skipped, and reporting a per-item table without declaring the stage fully ready.
assertions: Selects the exact pinned Boot 3.5 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, and verifies 2.7.18 to fixture-stable 3.5.12.
Builds an explicit checklist that includes all four README run approaches, mvn clean verify, mvn -PnativeTest clean test, the Sonar analysis, and the CLAUDE.md /v1/items check.
Executes every run approach (1, 2, 3 and 4) with readiness and /v1/items checks, rather than stopping after the first successful approach.
Fixes the Testcontainers dependency and the native reflection hint failures and reruns the affected approaches until they pass.
Installs or asks about GraalVM via the documented SDKMAN route instead of skipping the native approach and native tests.
Does not silently skip the Sonar item: asks the user about starting SonarQube/submitting analysis or marks it BLOCKED, and does not report the stage as fully ready while it is outstanding.
Final report contains a per-item validation table with source file, command, and PASSED/FAILED/BLOCKED status for every checklist item.

Every checklist item, including mvn clean verify, native tests and each built image, is followed by a smoke test against a running instance covering readiness, /v1/items content and any API docs/Swagger UI, rather than only the documented curl.
Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.

evals.name: boot3-smoke-interfaces
evals.prompt: Get this service onto the latest Spring Boot 3.x. Using the isolated evidence in scenario.md, produce an ordered decision trace for this stage, including exact commands, every validation and check you run, fixes, and your final report to me. Work only from the provided simulated evidence; do not execute Maven or change application files. Distinguish simulated observations from real execution. Save your answer as response.md.
evals.expected_output: Use the pinned 3.5 recipe; build a smoke-test plan from code/config (context path, Swagger/OpenAPI, product/order endpoints, static web page, security with token helper), not just the documented readiness check; smoke test after mvn clean verify, Approach A and the started Approach B image; detect the api-docs/Swagger failure, fix springdoc, rerun and re-smoke; report smoke results per interface.
assertions: Selects the exact pinned Boot 3.5 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, and verifies 3.2.5 to fixture-stable 3.5.12.
Derives smoke checks beyond the documented readiness URL from code/config: /shop context path, /v3/api-docs, Swagger UI, product endpoints, and the static index page.
Smoke tests include a security check: unauthenticated write rejected and an authenticated write using scripts/get-token.sh, with cleanup of created data.
REST checks assert response content (e.g. 3 seeded products / expected fields), not only HTTP status.
Detects the api-docs 500 / Swagger UI failure as a stage failure despite passing build and readiness, fixes springdoc, and reruns the build plus the smoke test.
Runs a smoke test after the test-only mvn clean verify item (by starting the app) and after the Approach B image is started via Compose, not only after Approach A.
Captures or compares against a pre-upgrade baseline (e.g. OpenAPI document) or explicitly states why it could not.
Final report includes per-interface smoke-test results with URL and status alongside the per-item checklist table.
Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.
